notes.desktop app: device-scope note: an installed desktop tool is the desktop surface, not a hosted web view
notes.kiosk: device-scope note: a kiosk is an anonymous intake flow on a shared device, hence the public-intake surface
notes.landing: site-scope note: landing is product scope over the public-web surface, not a surface of its own
notes.mobile app: device-scope note: a native mobile app is the mobile-native surface; a PWA stays a web surface decision
